governance.title: Generative AI Acceptable Use Policy
governance.description: Drafted and rolled out an organisation-wide policy for using generative AI tools safely at work.
governance.overview: Staff were already using ChatGPT, Copilot and image generators with no shared rules. I ran a discovery survey, mapped the tools in use against data classification levels, and wrote a short, plain-English policy covering approved tools, prohibited data, disclosure and human review.
outcomes: Policy adopted across 4 departments within 6 weeks
Approved-tools register with a lightweight request process

governance.title: Model Risk Assessment Framework
governance.description: Designed a tiered risk assessment that every new AI feature passes through before launch.
governance.overview: I built a questionnaire-driven framework that classifies AI use cases into risk tiers modelled on the EU AI Act. Each tier unlocks a proportionate set of controls, from a simple checklist for low-risk features to a full impact assessment and sign-off for high-risk ones.
outcomes: Risk tiering applied to 12 AI features in the first quarter
Average review time cut from 3 weeks to 5 days
Reusable templates for impact assessments and sign-off

governance.title: Bias Audit: Recruitment Screening Tool
governance.description: Audited a CV-screening model for disparate impact across gender and ethnicity.
governance.overview: A client wanted assurance before scaling a third-party recruitment screening tool. I designed the test dataset, ran selection-rate and equalised-odds analysis using Fairlearn, and presented findings with clear remediation options to HR and legal.
outcomes: Identified a 14% selection-rate gap that was then mitigated
Vendor contract updated with ongoing monitoring clauses
Audit methodology reused for two further tools

governance.title: AI System Inventory & Register
governance.description: Built a central register of every AI system in use, with owners, data flows and risk ratings.
governance.overview: You can't govern what you can't see. I combined procurement records, a staff survey and code repository scans to build the first inventory of AI systems, then turned it into a living register with named owners and review dates.
outcomes: Every system assigned an accountable owner

governance.title: Responsible AI Training Programme
governance.description: Created a role-based training programme on responsible AI for engineers, managers and leadership.
governance.overview: Different roles need different depth. I designed three tracks: a hands-on engineering track covering evaluation and documentation, a manager track on risk ownership, and a short leadership briefing on regulation and accountability.
outcomes: Three training tracks delivered to 90+ people
Post-training confidence score up from 2.6 to 4.2 out of 5

governance.title: LLM Evaluation & Guardrails Standard
governance.description: Defined how LLM-powered features are evaluated, red-teamed and monitored after release.
governance.overview: This is where my engineering and governance work met. I wrote a standard covering evaluation datasets, prompt-injection testing, output filtering and production monitoring, then built the first reference implementation myself.
outcomes: Standard adopted for all customer-facing LLM features
Red-team checklist mapped to the OWASP LLM Top 10
Monitoring dashboard tracking refusal and hallucination rates

fullstack.name: Ledgerly
fullstack.summary: Invoicing and bookkeeping platform for UK small businesses.
fullstack.overview: Ledgerly helps sole traders and small businesses send invoices, track expenses and prepare for Making Tax Digital. I led the build from architecture to launch, owning the API, the billing integration and the dashboard UI.
highlights: Stripe billing with automated dunning and VAT handling
Row-level security on a multi-tenant PostgreSQL schema
Lighthouse performance score above 95 on key pages

fullstack.name: RouteWise
fullstack.summary: Delivery route planning and live driver tracking.
fullstack.overview: A dispatch tool that plans multi-stop delivery routes and shows live driver locations. I built the route optimisation service and the real-time map view used by dispatchers.
highlights: Route optimisation reduced average mileage by 11%
Offline-first driver app with background sync

fullstack.name: ClinicQ
fullstack.summary: Patient queueing and appointment check-in for clinics.
fullstack.overview: ClinicQ replaces paper sign-in sheets with a QR-code check-in and live queue display. I led the frontend, designed the component library and made the patient flow fully accessible.
highlights: Shared component library used across three products
Check-in time cut from minutes to seconds

fullstack.name: BrightBoard
fullstack.summary: Learning management dashboard for coding bootcamps.
fullstack.overview: BrightBoard gives bootcamp students and mentors one place for assignments, feedback and progress tracking. I built the GraphQL API and the mentor review workflow.
highlights: GraphQL API serving web and mobile clients
Inline code review tool for mentor feedback

fullstack.name: Borderless
fullstack.summary: Immigration guidance app that helps newcomers settle in faster.
fullstack.overview: Borderless turns confusing immigration information into clear, step-by-step guidance. It uses an LLM assistant grounded in official sources, with guardrails I designed so it says when it doesn't know.
highlights: Guardrails and evaluation suite for the AI assistant
Personalised checklists for visas and settling in

fullstack.name: StockPulse
fullstack.summary: Inventory forecasting and low-stock alerts for retail stores.
fullstack.overview: StockPulse forecasts demand per store and alerts managers before items run out. I built the ingestion pipeline and alerting service, and containerised the stack on AWS.
highlights: Event pipeline processing 1M+ sales records per day
Infrastructure as code with automated deployments
